chunks: And it is narrated from Hisham ibn Ahmar that he said:
I carried money to Abu Ibrahim (peace be upon him) to Medina, so he said: 'Return it and deliver it to Al-Mufaddal ibn Umar.' So I returned it to Juffa and placed it at the door of Al-Mufaddal.

key_terms.الْمُدْفَعُ: the one to whom something is delivered

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Al-Kadhim instruct Hisham ibn Ahmar to do with the money he brought to Medina?
ai.summary: This narration from *Kitab al-Ghayba* highlights the trust placed in Al-Mufaddal ibn Umar as a key emissary during the Minor Occultation, illustrating the Imam's method of delegating financial resources through reliable deputies. By directing Hisham to leave the funds at Al-Mufaddal's door in Juffa, the Imam demonstrates the practical administration of the community's affairs while maintaining the secrecy of his physical presence.
